ryan (product): Heads-up: rolling out a quota rebalance and a short billing-safety mode next week to reduce churn from unexpected micro-overages. Planned cutover: 2026-04-28 10:00 UTC. Quick details below.
maria (finance): TL;DR on invoices? will credits show separately?
en (billing): We'll show any automatic adjustments as 'platform-policy-adjustment' on invoices. Small auto-credits (<= $60 incident cap, <= $200/mo) are applied automatically; larger deltas go to manual review. We'll hold provisional invoices up to 24h for affected accounts during the transition.
leo (support): Need support FAQ & opt-out toggle for enterprise customers. We'll staff the window.
ryan (product): Rollout plan (short): canary -> audit-only -> 10% -> global over 2 hours if stable. Safety triggers: error-rate increase >0.5% or auto-adjust rate >0.8% -> pause and notify SRE+Finance.
en (billing): Back-office rules: waive late fees for provisional invoices from this change; convert negative provisional invoices to account credit; flag accounts abnormally consuming credits for follow-up.
maria (finance): Confirming: suppress immediate charge attempts for accounts that receive adjustments during the 24h hold to avoid charge/refund churn. Legal approved wording for customer communication.
ryan (product): Customer message draft: "We're updating quota accounting to make billing fairer for short bursts. During rollout some customers may see small adjustments; eligible customers will receive a provisional invoice and can request a manual review."
leo (support): I'll prep canned replies and escalation contacts. Please ping #support-alerts at each milestone.
deploy-bot: scheduled: quota-rebalancer v2.0.0 -> us-west-2-canary at 2026-04-28T10:00:00Z.
ryan (product): Final: internal runbook: https://redwood.internal/docs/quota-rebalance. Posting FAQ and canned replies to this thread by EOD. Thanks all.
